```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```


Witt, Kemmerer, Linkenauger, & Culham (2010) presented evidence demonstrating a role for motor simulation in naming tools.  Specifically, participants were slower to name a tool when their hand that was closest to the tool's handle was already engaged in squeezing a ball when when the handle was oriented towards the unoccupied hand.

We re-analyzed the data using a multiverse analysis and Bayesian approach.

For the multiverse analysis, we manipulated outlier cut-offs, statistical test, and transformation of the dependent measure (reaction time; RT).

The outcomes suggest that the data do not support nor refute a role for motor simulation in tool identification.


```{r init}

setwd("C:/Users/jkwitt/Dropbox/Naming Tools Reanalysis")
require(reshape2)
require(lme4)
require(lmerTest)
require(BayesFactor)
require(emmeans)
require(lsr)
require(psych)
options(contrasts=c("contr.sum","contr.poly"))


```

Grab the data and determine potential outliers based on accuracy

```{r Get Data}


df <- read.csv("Data 4-8.csv")
length(unique(df$Subject))
df <- df[which(df$Subject > 1),]
length(unique(df$Subject))

df$isSame <- ifelse(df$HandCondition == 1 & df$Orientation == -1, 1,
                    ifelse(df$HandCondition == 1 & df$Orientation == 1, 0,
                           ifelse(df$HandCondition == 2 & df$Orientation == -1, 0,1)))
a <- aggregate(acc ~ Subject, df[which(df$Stim == "Tools"),], mean)
b <- boxplot(a$acc)
points(rep(1.1,length(a$Subject)), a$acc, col="red")
subjOuts <- a$Subject[which(a$acc <= max(b$out))]
df$accOut <- 0
for (i in subjOuts) {
  df$accOut[which(df$Subject == i)] <- 1
}

print(paste("Number of Ss whose mean accuracy score was beyond 1.5 x IQR =",length(subjOuts),"(accuracy was:"))
sort(round(b$out*100))

print(paste("Percent trials excluded in original paper =", round(length(which(df$StimPic.RT > 4000 & df$Stim == "Tools")) / length(which(df$Stim == "Tools")) * 100),"% (tools only)"))

print(paste("Percent trials excluded in original paper =", round(length(which(df$StimPic.RT > 4000)) / length(which(df$StimPic.RT > -10)) * 100),"% (both stim types"))


```

Set up data frames to save the outcomes from the multiverse analysis


```{r set up Exp 1 multiverse}

# Data frame for multiverse for RM ANOVA and LMERs
saveMulti <- data.frame(outlierCut = NA,
                        RTtransform = NA,
                        inclSlope = NA,
                        testType = NA,
                        estimate = NA,
                        SE = NA,
                        t = NA,
                        p = NA,
                        theta = NA,
                        converg = NA,
                        isSingular = NA,
                        trimACC = NA,
                        numTrials = NA)
sa <- 0  #corresponding index

# Data frame for multiverse for Bayes factors and effect sizes
saveBF <- data.frame(outlierCut = NA,
                        RTtransform = NA,
                        BF = NA,
                     trimACC = NA,
                     d = NA,
                     dLow = NA,
                     dHi = NA)
sb <- 0  #corresponding index


```

Run the multiverse for Experiment 1 re-analysis
```{r Exp 1 multiverse}

#for (ll in c(2,1)) {  #To include accuracy in multiverse (select 1)
  for (ll in c(2)) {  #Multiverse without accuracy (select 1)
    for (ii in c(1.5, 3, 10, 1000)) {
  for (jj in c("none","log")) {
      
      dd <- df[which(df$accOut < ll & df$Stim == "Tools"),]
      
      #Set-up DV
      dd$DV <- log(dd$StimPic.RT)
      if(jj == "none") {
        dd$DV <- dd$StimPic.RT
      }

      
      #Find outliers
      dd$RTout <- NA
      for (i in unique(dd$Subject)) {
          a <- which(dd$Subject == i)
          b <- boxplot(dd$DV[a], plot=F, range = ii)
          if(length(which(b$out > median(dd$DV[a]))) > 0) {
            minUp <- min(b$out[which(b$out > median(dd$DV[a], na.rm=T))])
            dd$RTout[which(dd$Subject == i & dd$DV >= minUp)] <- 1
          }
          if(length(which(b$out < median(dd$DV[a]))) > 0) {
            minUp <- max(b$out[which(b$out < median(dd$DV[a], na.rm=T))])
            dd$RTout[which(dd$Subject == i & dd$DV <= minUp)] <- 1
          }
          
      } #end for i
      
      #Remove outliers
      dd <- dd[which(is.na(dd$RTout)),]
      
      
      #Run lmer
      for (kk in c("yes","no")) {
        
      if(kk == "yes") {
        p1 <- lmer(DV ~ isSame +
                     (1 + isSame | Subject) +
                     (1 + isSame | Pic.Trial.) +
                     (1 | Subject:Pic.Trial.),
                   dd[which(dd$Stim == "Tools"),], 
                   control = lmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa"))
      } else {
        p1 <- lmer(DV ~ isSame +
                     (1 | Subject) +
                     (1 | Pic.Trial.) +
                     (1 | Subject:Pic.Trial.),
                   dd[which(dd$Stim == "Tools"),], 
                   control = lmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa"))
        
      }
      
      #Save outcomes lmer
      sa <- sa + 1
      saveMulti[sa,] <- NA
      saveMulti$outlierCut[sa] <- ii
      saveMulti$RTtransform[sa] <- jj
      saveMulti$inclSlope[sa] <- kk
      saveMulti$testType[sa] <- "lmer"
      saveMulti$estimate[sa] <- summary(p1)$coefficients[2,1]
      saveMulti$SE[sa] <- summary(p1)$coefficients[2,2]
      saveMulti$t[sa] <- summary(p1)$coefficients[2,4]
      saveMulti$p[sa] <- summary(p1)$coefficients[2,5]
      saveMulti$numTrials[sa] <- length(dd$Subject)
      tt <- getME(p1,"theta")
      lt <- getME(p1,"lower")
      saveMulti$theta[sa] <- min(tt[lt==0])
      
      ww <- summary(p1)
      a <- ww$optinfo$conv$lme4$code
      saveMulti$converg[sa] <- ifelse(is.null(a),90210,a)
      saveMulti$isSingular[sa] <- isSingular(p1)
      
      saveMulti$trimACC[sa] <- ll
    } #end for kk include random slopes
    
        
      
      # ANOVA (old way)
      mns <- aggregate(DV ~ Stim + isSame + Subject, dd[which(dd$Stim == "Tools"),], mean)
      mns$Subject <- as.factor(mns$Subject)
      mns$isSame <- as.factor(mns$isSame)
      p1 <- aov(DV ~ (isSame) + 
                  Error(Subject / (isSame)), 
                data = mns[which(mns$Stim == "Tools"),])
      #a <- summary(p1)
      #a <- a$`Error: Subject:isSame`
      b <- emmeans(p1,specs = "isSame")
      bb <- as.data.frame(pairs(b))

      #Save outcomes ANOVA
      
      sa <- sa + 1
      saveMulti[sa,] <- NA
      saveMulti$outlierCut[sa] <- ii
      saveMulti$RTtransform[sa] <- jj
      saveMulti$testType[sa] <- "aov"
      saveMulti$estimate[sa] <- bb$estimate
      saveMulti$SE[sa] <- bb$SE
      saveMulti$t[sa] <- bb$t.ratio
      saveMulti$p[sa] <- bb$p.value
      saveMulti$trimACC[sa] <- ll

      
      
      # t test bayes factor
      mns <- aggregate(DV ~ Stim + isSame + Subject, dd[which(dd$Stim == "Tools"),], mean)
      mns <- dcast(mns, Subject ~ isSame, value.var = "DV")
      p1 <- extractBF(ttestBF(mns$`0`, mns$`1`, paired = T, rscale = .3))$bf

      #Save outcomes ttest Bayes factor
      sb <- sb + 1
      saveBF[sb,] <- NA
      saveBF$outlierCut[sb] <- ii
      saveBF$RTtransform[sb] <- jj
      saveBF$BF[sb] <- p1
      saveBF$trimACC[sb] <- ll
      a <- psych::cohen.d.ci(d = cohensD(mns$`0`, mns$`1`, method = "paired"), n1 = length(mns$`0`))
      saveBF$d[sb] <- a[2]
      saveBF$dLow[sb] <- a[1]
      saveBF$dHigh[sb] <- a[3]
      
      
  } #end for jj transform
} #end for ii outlier cut-off
} #end for ll incl acc outs
  
saveMulti$estimate[which(saveMulti$testType == "aov")] <- -1 * saveMulti$estimate[which(saveMulti$testType == "aov")]
saveMulti$outlierCutF <- as.factor(saveMulti$outlierCut)
saveMulti$RTtransform <- as.factor(saveMulti$RTtransform)
saveMulti$inclSlopeF <- ifelse(is.na(saveMulti$inclSlope),"no",saveMulti$inclSlope)
saveMulti$inclSlopeF <- as.factor(saveMulti$inclSlopeF)
saveMulti$testType <- as.factor(saveMulti$testType)

saveMulti$x <- (as.integer(saveMulti$testType) * 10) + 
  as.integer(saveMulti$outlierCutF) + 
  (as.integer(saveMulti$inclSlopeF)/10)
saveMulti$x2 <- (as.integer(saveMulti$outlierCutF) * 10) + 
  as.integer(saveMulti$testType) + 
  as.integer(saveMulti$inclSlopeF)
saveMulti$pch <- ifelse(saveMulti$testType == "aov", 15,
                        ifelse(saveMulti$inclSlope == "yes", 0, 1))


```


```{r print some outcomes}


print(paste("Proportion of significant p values =",
            round(length(which(saveMulti$p <= .05)) / length(saveMulti$p) * 100,0),"%"))
print(paste("Proportion of BF greater than 3 =",
            round(length(which(saveBF$BF >= 3)) / length(saveBF$BF) * 100,0),"%"))
print(paste("Proportion of BF less than 1/3 =",
            round(length(which(saveBF$BF <= (1/3))) / length(saveBF$BF) * 100,0),"%"))


countTrials <- aggregate(numTrials ~ outlierCut + RTtransform, saveMulti, mean)

countTrials$propInc <- round(countTrials$numTrials / max(countTrials$numTrials) * 100)
countTrials$propExc <- round((1 - (countTrials$numTrials / max(countTrials$numTrials))) * 100)
countTrials
```

```{r Exp 1 Generate Plot of Outcomes}

if(1>0) {  # do figure w four panels
```

I could not find the raw data from Experiment 2, so limited to analyzing the means

```{r Experiment 2}

## Means from SPSS file
pp <- read.csv("exp2meansFromSPSS.csv", header=T)
pf <- melt(pp, id.vars = "subj")
pf$isTool <- ifelse(as.integer(pf$variable) < 9, 1, 0)
pf$orient <- ifelse(as.integer(pf$variable) < 5, 1, 
             ifelse(as.integer(pf$variable) < 9, 2, 
             ifelse(as.integer(pf$variable) < 13, 1, 2)))
durs <- c(167,17,33,50)
pf$dur <- durs[as.integer(pf$variable) %% 4 + 1]


# Analyze it the old way - check!
options(contrasts=c("contr.sum","contr.poly"))
pf$subj <- as.factor(pf$subj)
pf$durF <- as.factor(pf$dur)
pf$orientF <- as.factor(pf$orient)
p1 <- aov(value ~ (durF * orientF) + 
            Error(subj / (durF * orientF)), 
          data = pf[which(pf$isTool == 1),])
summary(p1)
interaction.plot(pf$dur, pf$orient, pf$value, type="b", col=c("blue","red"))


p1 <- lmer(value ~ orient * dur + (1 + orient * dur | subj),
           pf[which(pf$isTool == 1),],
           control = lmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa"))
summary(p1)

pt <- aggregate(value ~ orient + subj, pf[which(pf$isTool == 1),], mean)
pt <- dcast(pt, subj ~ orient, value.var = "value")
t.test(pt$`1`, pt$`2`,paired = T)
BayesFactor::ttestBF(pt$`1`, pt$`2`,paired = T, rscale = .3)

}
```
